Slop Timesheets · free, in your browser

A free timesheet with a timer

Start the timer when you begin, or type the time afterwards. Slop Timesheets totals your hours by week or month, per customer and project, in your browser.

Start a timesheet

How to do it

  1. Type what you are working on and choose Start timer. Choose Stop when you finish; the entry opens with the time filled in.
  2. Or choose Log time and type Time worked as 1:30, 1.5 or 90m.
  3. Pick the Customer and Project, and tick Billable if the time is for a customer, with your Hourly rate.
  4. Save, then pick a Period (This week, Last week, This month, Last month) to see the totals.
  5. Choose Download CSV to export what is shown.

Your files stay on this device: Slop Timesheets runs in your browser, with no upload, no account and no watermark.

Questions

Does the timer keep running if I close the tab?

Yes. The start time is kept in this browser, so a reload or another tab keeps the timer going. Nothing is saved to the timesheet until you save the entry.

Do weeks start on Monday?

Yes. This week and Last week run Monday to Sunday.

Can I log time that is not for a customer?

Yes. Untick Billable and it is internal time, with no customer. It counts in your totals but is never billed.
